strings.(이오가 생각에 빠졌는지 멍한 표정으로 서 있다.): (Io stands absentmindedly, apparently lost in thought.)
Io, what is it you don't understand?
When I encountered that power of destruction...
strings.그런 불경한 생각은 버리도록 하거라. 그때만 생각하면 아직도 소름이 돋는: Put aside such unholy thoughts. Even remembering that moment gives me goosebumps.
strings.물과 얼음의 정령께서 돋을 소름이 있어?: Can a spirit of water and ice get goosebumps?
strings.(나린이 그 말에 자신의 팔을 들어 바라본다.): (Narin raises an arm and examines it.)
strings.미안, 정령이 소름이 돋을 리 없지. 그런데 말이다. 네가 모험가님을 불: My mistake. Of course a spirit cannot. But did you call the adventurer? They're coming...
strings.별일은 아니고, 게르다를 구경하고 있었어요. 이런 눈을 보는 건 흔치 않: Nothing special. I was looking around Gerda. Snow like this is a rare sight for me. It really makes me want to stay.
Thank you for saying that. I love hearing that people want to stay in Gerda.
Nothing much. I remembered when I felt that power of destruction...
strings.괜찮아. 걱정할 필요 없어. 지금 살아있으니까. 괜찮아야 또 다른 것도: It's all right. Don't worry. I'm alive now. I need to be all right so I can do other things well too.
There you go again, Io. You're doing well. Don't worry.
strings.그래, 고마워. 너밖에 없다…. 역시 이 말이 듣고 싶어서 그런 거지?: Thank you. You're the only one... You just wanted to hear that, didn't you?
strings.물론이지…. 그 말이 맞단다. 그래도 조금은 서운하구나. 이 몸이 곁에: Of course. Quite right. Still, I was a little hurt. Even with me beside you, you kept seeking out that wretched creature... Hmph.
strings.둘이 친구 시켜주려고 해도 서로 싫다고 했잖아. 그리고 메아리의 샘에 들: I tried to make you two friends, but you both refused. And you couldn't enter Echo Spring. Besides, how was I supposed to know it was an evil spirit?
strings.내가 미르에게 어르신 산에서 자라는 네 전용 음식 재료 부탁했으니 화 풀: I asked Mir to bring ingredients just for you from the elder's mountain. So don't be angry.
If you've gone that far, I shall gladly accept.
%s, you were just thinking what a strange human and spirit we are, weren't you?
Look at you jump... Shynic was right. You're fun to tease. Anyway, good timing.
You're coming somewhere with me. I need to visit Medea.
Something came up. I need you there, so let's go together.
I'll explain when we arrive. Predictable as that sounds...
strings.칼리에 가기 전에 물건을 하나 찾아야 해. 너와 같이 가야 메아리의 샘의: Before Kali, we need to find something. I can only see the other side of Echo Spring if you're with me.
strings.메아리의 샘은 헤매지 않으려면 나도 있어야겠지?: And you'll need me there if you don't want to get lost, right?
You're always busy, Io. It's important, so take care.
Thank you, Narin. I'll be back soon.
strings.(칼리 마을의 하늘을 멍하니 바라보고 있던 메디아가 눈을 감는다. 함께: (Medea closes her eyes after gazing absently at Kali's sky. Merimel, sharing tea with her, looks puzzled.)
The barrier I worked so hard to strengthen is becoming less meaningful by the day.
A guest is coming. From the distant northern sea...
strings.(북해라는 말이 나오자마자 메리멜이 놀란다.): (Merimel startles at the mention of the northern sea.)
strings.이오 님! 이오 님! 이오 님이 오신다는 건가요?: Io! Io! You mean Io is coming?
Ah... Merimel, you're a fan of Io as well as Shynic.
Now I can die without regrets...
I'll introduce you to Io. Wait here.
strings.네, 네!! %s 님도 오셨네요. 안녕하세요? 전에 주신 부품은 잘 쓰고: Yes, yes! Oh, %s is here too. Hello! The parts you gave me are working well.
strings.메리멜도 있었네요. 그거 잘 쓰고 있다니 다행이에요. 안녕하세요, 메디아: You're here too, Merimel. I'm glad they're useful. Hello, Medea.
%s, you've come as well. Ah, welcome, Io.
strings.메디아 양, 갑작스럽게 와서 미안해. 그동안 잘 있었어? 저번에 못 본: Sorry for the sudden visit, Medea. Have you been well? I was disappointed not to see you last time.
strings.그러면 잠시 기다리시지요. 차를 준비할 동안 이 아이 상대를 해주셨으면: Then wait a moment. Keep this girl company while I prepare tea. Oh, I have some coffee Atkina gave me. Would you like that?
strings.그래, 알았어. 이 아이 이름이 메리멜이었지?: Yes, that sounds good. Your name is Merimel, right?
strings.어, 어, 어떻게!! 제 이름을 알고 계신가요?!: H-how do you know my name?!
strings.놀라지 마. 메디아가 이야기를 많이 해줬어. 마을에 착하고 예쁘고 능력: Don't be so surprised. Medea has told me a lot. That there's a kind, pretty, talented girl in the village, and she feels sorry for keeping her here...
I never imagined she'd say that about me...
I saw you as a baby. You've grown so much. Come to Gerda with Medea sometime. We have a Kali in our village too.
strings.정말 가도 되나요? 그런데 칼리 족이 있어요?: May I really? But there's a Kali there?
Yes. Titi... Medea knows him too. Thank you for the coffee.
strings.메리멜, 티티는 오래 전 우리 마을이 아드리카로 내려올 때 행방불명됐던: Merimel, Titi is the child who disappeared long ago, when our village descended to Adrika.
strings.소식을 몰라 죽은 줄 알았었는데, 게르다에서 지낸다는 소식을 들었을 땐: With no news, we thought he had died. I was so happy to hear he was living in Gerda.
Of course. Eating well, sleeping well, and looking after the ice.
strings.아냐, 티티가 잘하고 있어서 그래. 아, 맞다. 내가 메디아 양을 위해: No, he's doing well through his own efforts. Oh, right. I brought something for you, Medea.
strings.예전 칼리 마을에 있었던 거랑 제일 비슷한 블루베리하고, 북해에서 잡을: Blueberries as close as I could find to those from the old Kali village, and delicious fish from the northern sea. You liked these, didn't you?
strings.(메디아 님, 잠깐이지만 설레는 표정이었는데….): (For just a moment, Medea looked excited...)
strings.그리고 이건…. 아, 메리멜. 잠깐 자리를 비켜줄래? 저녁에 같이 식사: And this is... Oh, Merimel, could you give us a moment? Shall we have dinner together later?
I'd love to, Io. Then, Medea, %s, enjoy your conversation. I'll see you later.
What a good girl. I'll be sure to call you.
strings.(메리멜이 물러나자 이오가 얼음 상자에서 가져온 얼음 날개를 꺼낸다.): (Once Merimel leaves, Io takes the ice wings from the ice box she brought.)
Medea, I'd like you to look at this and tell me your story.
Before that, %s... There's something I'd like you to do.
strings.샤이닉이 곧 마을로 다가올 테니, 밖에서 잠시만 상대해주시겠어요?: Shynic will be here soon. Would you keep her company outside for a little while?
She mustn't see the object Io has brought out...
I don't know what's happening, but I'll go meet Shynic. How long should I keep her?
I'll come outside when it's time.
All right. I'll keep her occupied.
strings.(아드리카에서 칼리 마을 입구로 들어가는 길목, 빛에 가까울 정도의 빠른: (On the path from Adrika to Kali's entrance, a figure approaches at almost the speed of light.)
Sniff, sniff. You smell less now.
That smell is fading. I'm glad...
You know, don't you? ♡ Your goddess must have told you something.
strings.이리스가 이야기하긴 했는데, 그 냄새하고도 연관된 게 맞나요?: Iris did tell me, but is that really connected to the smell?
strings.맞아. 나는 싫든 좋든 죽음의 냄새를 맡을 수 있어. 아가슈라는 그 냄새: Yes. Like it or not, I can smell death. Agasuras reek of it so strongly I want to hold my nose. But you weren't like that.
strings.명계에 머물렀던 페르세가 나를 그렇게 만들어놓아서 정말 귀찮다니까. 삶과: Perse made me this way while she was staying in the Underworld. It's such a nuisance. When you cross the boundary between life and death as easily as I do, these are the sorts of things you sense.
strings.(샤이닉이 쓸쓸한 눈빛을 지어 보이다가 방긋 웃는다.): (Shynic's eyes turn wistful for a moment, then she smiles brightly.)
Don't worry. The smell isn't strong anymore♡ Just remember to wash properly.
strings.그런데 안 비키고 뭐 해? 나 메디아 보러 가는 길인데, 칼리 마을에 이: Anyway, why are you still blocking my way? I'm here to see Medea. Io's in Kali Village, isn't she?
strings.무슨 일 있지? 말해. 안 그러면 지금 우리 둘이 같이 지옥으로 갈 수도: Something's going on, isn't it? Tell me. Otherwise, the two of us might end up going straight to hell♡
Actually, I'd better ask those two coming this way.
strings.(샤이닉의 말마따나 칼리 마을 안쪽에서 이오와 메디아가 걸어오고 있다.): (Just as Shynic says, Io and Medea are approaching from inside Kali Village.)
Medea, Io! I'm here. Io, that's lovely, but don't hug me. It's too hot.
%s, thank you for doing this, even though it was a lot to ask.
Shynic, I asked %s to keep you occupied for a little while.
strings.괜찮아, 괜찮아. 메디아가 뭔가 할 일이 있었겠지. 대신 자주 놀러 올: That's fine, that's fine. I'm sure you had something to do, Medea. Just know that I'll be visiting often in return♡
strings.…그 물건이 뭔데, 날 막은 거야?: …What was it that made you keep me out?
strings.샤이닉 언니가 폭주하게끔 바이스가 놓은 덫이야. 아발론에 가려면 데보라를: A trap Weiss set to make you lose control, Shynic. You have to pass through Deborah to reach Avalon.
strings.준비한 그날이 되어 샤이닉 언니가 데보라에 오는 순간, 언니는 폭주하게: When the appointed day comes, you'll lose control the moment you arrive in Deborah.
strings.바이스가 어떤 못된 정령의 날개에 속박과 마녀의 힘을 섞어 이면에 던져놓: Weiss mixed the power of Binding and the witch's power into a wicked spirit's wings, then cast them onto the other side.
strings.그래서 %s에게 발견을, 메디아 양에게 정화를 부탁했어요. 이면에 있어서: So I asked %s to find them and Medea to purify them. Being on the other side weakened the Binding, but only Medea can neutralize the witch's power.
If you'd arrived in Kali before the purification was finished….
…So that's why you asked me to look after Shynic.
You went to all this trouble because of me….
No, it's all right. We were going to do it anyway.
strings.안 되겠어. 그 나쁜 놈들, 다 지옥 보내고 나도 가야겠어♡: That's it. I'm sending those scoundrels straight to hell, and I'll go with them♡
Let's do it together. I'm bound for hell anyway.
strings.(저런 이야기를 너무 자연스럽게 한다니까….): (They talk about these things so casually….)
strings.시간이 얼마 남지 않았다는 걸 잘 알고 있습니다. 아직 해야할 일이 있어: I know very well that there isn't much time left. There are still things I must do….
strings.(메디아가 말을 이어가던 중, 귀를 쫑긋거린다.): (Medea pricks up her ears as she speaks.)
strings.식사 준비가 다 끝난 것 같군요. 이오 님께서 가져오신 재료들을 더해서: It seems the meal is ready. Thanks to the ingredients Io brought, we have quite a feast. Please follow me.
strings.나 들어가도 괜찮아?: Is it all right for me to come in?
strings.괜찮지 않다면 타르타로스로 돌아가실 겁니까?: Would you return to Tartaros if it weren't?
strings.아니♡ 놀다 갈 거야!: Nope♡ I'm staying to have some fun!
You're good at handling Shynic, Medea….
strings.그런 말도 안되는 말씀을…. %s, 같이 식사하러 가시죠. 그리고 따로: What an absurd thing to say…. %s, please join us for a meal. There is also something I'd like to discuss with you privately.
strings.(파란색 나무 식탁 위에 칼리 일족의 음식과 게르다에서 가져온 재료들로: (The blue wooden dining table is laden with Kali dishes and food made from ingredients brought from Gerda. The meal begins when Shynic picks up a plate.)
strings.(오랜만의 손님을 맞은 특별한 식사가 끝날 때쯤, 메디아가 메리멜을 서둘: (As the special meal for the long-awaited guests draws to a close, Medea sends Merimel on her way and quietly addresses %s.)
There is something I must tell you.
strings.모험가님의 다음 여정이 될 수도 있는 그 장소 근처에 다녀와 주셨으면 합: I'd like you to visit the area near a place that may be your next destination.
If you go there and sense its energy, it will help me with my work….
We may be able to hinder the one who sent you that message telling you to wait for the night.
strings.그건 어떻게 아셨나요?: How did you know about that?
She told me as well…. The night she has waited so long for….
…She may eventually have an adverse influence on the goddess as well….
strings.구체적으로 어디인지 알 수 없지만, 누구에게 가야 하는지는 알고 있습니다: I don't know the exact place, but I know whom you should visit.
strings.칼리 족 사람을 만나 운명에 이끌리듯 끝에 다가가면 답이 보일지도 몰라요: Meet with members of the Kali tribe and follow where fate leads you. At the end, you may find your answer….
If anyone notices you searching for that answer, tell them about me. You may tell them everything you know.
strings.정말 그래도 되나요?: Are you sure that's all right?
strings.그럴게요. 그러면 노엘하고 티티를 찾아가면 되나. 메디아 님, 절 왜 그: All right. Then I should go see Noel and Titi. Medea, why are you looking at me like that?
…Something about you has changed since we last met.
I believe it's the goddess's influence. You have certainly grown stronger….
strings.신뢰의 크기에 대해선 걱정하시지 않으셔도 됩니다. 칼리 일족은 당신을 믿: You needn't worry about how much we trust you. The Kali tribe has faith in you….
Thank you, Medea. I'll visit Noel as soon as I can.
strings.그래요, 부탁드릴게요…. 가시는 길에 티티에게도 안부 전해주세요. 저는: Yes, please do…. Give Titi my regards along the way. Tell her I'm well….
strings.이야기는 다 들었어♡, 내가 뭘 하면 돼?: I heard everything♡ What can I do?
strings.어떻게 나에게 그렇게 심심한 상태를 유지하라는 거야♡: How can you ask me to stay in such a boring state♡
I wasn't expecting you to listen anyway….
strings.마녀가 나타났다면 내가 모를 리가 없는데, 참 신기하단 말이지. 여기저기: It's strange. There's no way I wouldn't notice if a witch appeared. She's been stirring up trouble with Weiss everywhere, yet I've never had a proper look at her.
She can conceal her presence. She has even appeared in my form….
I'll teach that rabbit witch a lesson.
Yes, I should go see Noel.
strings.노엘에게는 별일 없냐만 묻고, 다음 칼리 족 사람을 만나러 가. 알았지?: Just ask Noel if everything is all right, then go see the next member of the Kali tribe. Understood?
strings.네, 그럴게요. 아, 이오는 어떻게 할 거예요?: Yes, I will. Oh, what about you, Io?
strings.나? 흠…, 칼리에 며칠 더 있을까? 저기, 메디아 양? 표정 풀어. 이: Me? Hmm… maybe I'll stay in Kali a few more days. Um, Medea? Don't look like that. I'm only joking.
I'm going to Dragon Valley to see Atkina.
strings.그래, 이오. 그리고 나중에 또 올게, 메디아. 이번에는 결계 맛도 못: All right, Io. I'll visit again, Medea. What a shame I have to leave without even getting a taste of your barrier this time.
strings.그런 아쉬운 소리 나오지 않게 더욱 강한 결계를 준비하겠습니다. 이런,: I'll prepare a stronger barrier so you won't have cause to say that again. Oh dear, she's already gone….
strings.어, 샤이닉 님? 저랑 같이 가는 거 아니었어요? 먼저 그렇게 뛰어가시면: Huh? Shynic? Weren't we going together? You can't just run off ahead of me….
She said, "Let's go," but she never said "together."
Sigh, I suppose there's nothing I can do. Goodbye, then. I'd better get going too.
strings.(두 사람이 사라지고, 이오와 메디아가 식탁을 정리한다. 그러다 서로의: (After the two leave, Io and Medea clear the table. When their eyes meet, Io quietly speaks.)
strings.메디아 양은 그날이 되면 바이스를 어떻게 할 거야?: What will you do with Weiss when that day comes?
I'm asking what you want, Medea.
